description: This Java class 'CpmFileModel' models the contents of a component placement file, providing methods to parse such files, extract component references, and organize components by package and reference. It handles reading a specific textual format, extracting relevant data, and storing components in a map indexed by a composite key.

classes.name: CpmFileModel
classes.description: A model representing component placement data parsed from a specific file format, including methods to read and process the file content.

methods.name: readCmpFile
methods.description: Reads and parses the component file from a list of strings, extracting components and storing them in a map by a composite key.

methods.name: parseValueLine
methods.description: Extracts and cleans the value from a line in the file.

methods.name: parseReferenceLine
methods.description: Extracts and cleans the reference identifier from a line in the file.

methods.name: cutLastSymbol
methods.description: Removes the last character from a string, used to clean parsed data.
